verdict.rationale: The MI325X is a GPU accelerator, and GPU-class products can ship hardware video engines and ISV-certified drivers, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only ROCm compute and AI libraries, cluster and Kubernetes tooling, and CDNA3 compute and memory specs. It never mentions AV1 or HEVC encode, media engines, creator-app acceleration, or professional/ISV driver certification.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it
